signatureBehavior.name: the light field
signatureBehavior.summary: Every lit pixel's colour is chosen from one of eight shade planes. The shade is computed in hardware from four positioned lights and an ambient level by a 3-bit adder that wraps. A probe latch reports the shade and base colour the beam produced at one chosen pixel.

rule.shade: (AMBIENT + sum of the four levels) mod 8
rule.unlit: tiles and sprites flagged unlit use the FIXED shade register instead of the computed shade
rule.latching: light registers are sampled at the start of each scanline and hold for that line
rule.probe: when the beam outputs the pixel at (PX, PY) the chip latches that pixel's shade and base colour index and sets a ready flag

techniques.name: Lantern
techniques.description: Shade planes filled with darkening ramps; one light follows the player through an ambient dark. Documented in the launch development kit.

techniques.name: Gel swap
techniques.description: Shade planes filled with unrelated colours so that light recolours instead of brightening: hidden ink visible only when lit, colour washes and X-ray effects.

techniques.name: Flying
techniques.description: Rewriting light registers from the LINE interrupt so each band of the screen sees different lights: more than four lights, and per-line shapes such as flames, beams and roads drawn with no tile memory.

techniques.name: Overdrive
techniques.description: Deliberately overflowing the 3-bit shade adder so overlapping lights wrap into contour rings and faceted interference patterns.

techniques.name: Follow-spot
techniques.description: Moving the probe (and lights) mid-frame to use the light field as a coprocessor: hardware distance and visibility queries for game logic.
